title: Rockstar Reveals £350 GTA6 Collectibles Box
description: Rockstar Games has announced a limited Goodtime State Vice City collection for GTA6 priced at £349, which does not include the game and is available for pre-order now.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar Reveals £350 GTA6 Collectibles Box You Definitely Wouldn't Get Through Airport Security

As anticipation continues to build for the eventual release of Grand Theft Auto 6, Rockstar Games has announced a brand-new, high-end merchandise offering for fans of the franchise. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, the developer has unveiled a limited-edition collectibles package named the “Goodtime State Vice City” collection.

### A Pricey Package Without the Game

Priced at a staggering £349, this deluxe merchandise box leans heavily into the extravagant lifestyle associated with the iconic setting of Vice City. However, one detail has already sparked considerable debate within the gaming community: **the box does not include a copy of the game itself**. Buyers paying the £349 price tag will strictly be acquiring the physical collectibles, meaning a separate purchase will be required to actually play GTA6 when it launches. Despite this, pre-orders for the collection are officially open now.

### Designed for Hardcore Collectors

According to the details shared by Eurogamer, the collection features a series of naughty and uniquely styled items that match the edgy, rebellious tone of the GTA universe. The items are designed with such distinct aesthetics that reviewers have joked about their ability to clear standard airport security checks.

While high-priced collector's editions and merchandise bundles are a staple for major blockbuster releases, separating the physical memorabilia from the game software at such a high price point highlights Rockstar's immense confidence in the game's dedicated fanbase and merchandise market.

### Editor's Take

A £349 price tag for a box of goodies that doesn't even include the game is a bold move, appealing almost exclusively to hardcore collectors and die-hard fans. While the naughty collectibles and Vice City themed items look undeniably tempting, average players may want to think twice before pre-ordering.
